## Fixed
- **The Capture Crate can now be crafted on Minecraft 1.21.1.** Its recipe was written in a newer format that 1.21.1 cannot read, so the game skipped it entirely and the crafting grid produced nothing. The Crate has been uncraftable on 1.21.1 since it was introduced in v0.3.0; the Capture Net recipe was unaffected and always worked.

## Notes
- No other changes — the Crate itself, the Capture Net, and everything else behave exactly as before.
- Playing on a newer Minecraft version? This only ever affected 1.21.1; the Crate crafts normally everywhere else.
